phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The dimensionless field α is the flux through one square lattice cell divided by one flux quantum. The paper estimates α=1 at about 10^9 G for a≈2 Å and about 100 kG for a≈200 Å; these scale estimates follow directly from the α definition.

For rational α=p/q, the q-step transfer matrix Q supplies the bounded-state criterion |Tr Q(ε;ν)|≤2. After taking the union over phase ν, with Tr Q(ε;ν)=Tr Q(ε)+2f(ν) and unit-amplitude f, the spectrum is selected by |Tr Q(ε)|≤4.
At α=p/q in lowest terms, the Bloch band splits into exactly q energy bands. For even q, the two central bands meet at ε=0 and can appear as q−1 separated intervals although the band count remains q.

The spectrum obeys unit periodicity in α, invariance under α→−α, particle-hole symmetry ε→−ε, and the global energy bound −4≤ε≤4; consequently one unit field interval and the stated energy range determine the full graph.

Computed Harper spectrum over 0≤β={α}≤1 and −4≤ε≤4, using rational fields whose reduced denominators are less than 50. The numerical object is the union of allowed energy bands for each sampled rational flux.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Sec. IV, pp. 2242-2243, Statement I and pure/special-case discussion
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: At pure cases β=1/N or 1−1/N there are N bands across a cell (the even-N unit-cell central touching makes only N−1 separated intervals visible). Pure-band width divided by adjacent-gap width tends to zero as N grows; the selected center bands of special cases also narrow toward stated limiting band edges.

Numerical unit-cell skeleton formed from spectra at pure cases β=1/N and 1−1/N through N=37, plus the central band at the lower and upper special cases. Straight connections of computed band edges define the labelled L, C, and R subcell chains.

Rectangularized numerical spectrum of subcell L₂: each height is linearly stretched to constant cell width and replotted against the subcell local variable, testing recurrence of the butterfly gap structure.
Rectangularized numerical spectrum of subcell C₂ using a smaller band set; the displayed bands are the pure-case part of that subcell's skeleton and test the same recursive construction.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Unnumbered spectrum and cluster display, Sec. V, p. 2244
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: For α=5/17, the displayed 17-band spectrum is claimed to decompose 5-7-5 across L/C/R chains, with full symbolic hierarchy (2-1-2)-(2-3-2)-(2-1-2). This is an explicit discrete numerical output of the recursive band-clustering algorithm.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Sec. VI and start of Sec. VII, p. 2245
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: For irrational α, the recursively defined spectrum is claimed to be an uncountable measure-zero Cantor set. Its Lebesgue measure M(α) is positive at rationals and zero at irrationals, hence discontinuous at every rational and continuous at every irrational, while the spectral set itself varies continuously in the stated setwise sense.

Taking the union of spectra within a field window of height Δα yields a blurred spectrum whose band count is bounded by 1/Δα+1 for every α and whose band edges vary smoothly; positive Δα removes arbitrarily fine structure while Δα→0 recovers it.

One quadrant of the numerically smeared spectrum produced with field uncertainty Δα=1/100. The reproducible object is the union of nearby exact spectra over that window, not a pixel-derived silhouette.

For β=(N+x)⁻¹ at small β, nested C-cell chains imply roughly N≈1/β Landau levels across the Bloch band (about N/2 on each side), all split with the spectrum(x)=spectrum(1/β) pattern, and adjacent Landau-level spacing roughly 8βE₀.

The Harper coefficients and Bloch-Floquet solutions have minimal magnetic period P=1/α, including noninteger and irrational α. For α=p/q, folding integer samples into one period orders them by successive multiples of p̄ modulo q, where p̄p≡1 (mod q).

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Unnumbered integer-order/reordered-order diagrams, Sec. IX, pp. 2247-2248
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: For α=5/17, p̄=7 and the displayed folded order is 0,7,14,4,11,1,8,15,5,12,2,9,16,6,13,3,10,0, obtained as successive multiples of 7 modulo 17 across one magnetic period.

Reordered wave-function values within one period P=1/α for α=1/5, 2/11, and 17/93, at largest eigenvalues ε=2.9664, 3.02850, and 3.023983268 respectively. The three overlaid series test convergence toward a common continuous irrational-field wave-function shape; amplitudes are normalized so the highest dot is 1.

The field-effect-transistor synthetic-lattice experiment is a proposed apparatus and measurement route, not a reported experimental dataset or numerical figure. Its two scale estimates are inventoried separately under claim_field_scale.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: The paper's q-band construction and the global butterfly are independently supported, but the frozen float64 data collapses five strictly positive high-q bands to exactly zero width. Because T001 claims every q<50 band, the paper-exact numerical claim is not fully resolved.

independent_checks.claim: 755/755 expected reduced fractions; every group has q indexed intervals; flux-reflection residual 3.24e-14 and energy-inversion residual 4.26e-14.
At α=1/2, generated edges equal [-2√2,0] and [0,2√2] within 2.45e-16.

Five frozen rows have high==low. Independent 90-digit diagonalization finds positive widths: 1/41 band 38 =7.8796e-17, 36/37 band 0 =1.8499e-18, 38/39 band 38 =1.7518e-19, 43/44 band 1 =5.1527e-20, and 47/48 band 6 =1.1413e-14.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The frozen T001 data resolves every strictly positive q<50 band width.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: The pure/special band families are present at the printed N≤37 scope, but the scientific connector construction is not the paper's L/C/R skeleton. The renderer chooses the band nearest ε=0 at every mixed row and draws only global center/envelope polylines, instead of separately connecting next-to-outermost pure bands and neighboring special-case center bands.

independent_checks.claim: The 1,438 rows equal the two pure families for N=2..37 plus one central band for each lower/upper special family N=2..18, including the duplicated coincident 1/2 pure endpoint.
At α=1/5 the paper's next-to-outermost left band is index 1 with edges [-1.3484140004,-0.9021130326], whereas render_skeleton selects central index 2 with edges [-0.3819660113,0.3819660113].

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The Fig. 2 implementation follows the paper-defined L/C/R connector construction.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: The L₂ coordinate and affine-energy transformation pass independent checks, but the paper does not state its rational sampling cutoff and the bundle provides only one q≤79 realization, not a convergence series. The declared paper_subset result cannot be promoted to paper-supported for the full figure.

independent_checks.claim: All 1,162 rows lie in [0,1]; the maximum α′ mapping residual is 6.66e-16 across 98 unique source fluxes.
At α=2/9, an independently constructed Harper matrix, paper-derived boundary interpolation, and affine normalization yield the same two retained intervals with zero float64 discrepancy.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The L2 coordinate transformation and sampled interior intervals are numerically correct.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: Although the C₂ coordinate map is correct, the paper caption states that every displayed Fig. 4 band belongs to the pure-case skeleton of that subcell. The implementation samples all outer rational fluxes up to denominator 79; 329 of 513 frozen intervals are attached to non-pure local fluxes.

independent_checks.claim: The C₂ mapping residual for α′=α/(1−2α)−2 is at most 1.44e-15 and the endpoints 2/5 and 3/7 map to 0 and 1.
Among 57 unique source fluxes, 32 map to a local rational other than 1/N or 1−1/N. Those non-pure fluxes contribute 329/513 interval rows; examples include outer α=32/79→local 2/15 and 28/69→2/13.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The frozen Fig. 4 data contains only local pure-case skeleton intervals.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: The implementation doubles the paper's field-smearing window. The paper defines a window of total height Δα and explicitly calls the jiggling amplitude Δα/2; EQ006 and blurred_quadrant instead dilate by ±Δα, producing a total height 2Δα.

independent_checks.claim: On the 480-row α∈[0,0.5] grid, the stored array exactly equals a radius-10-row (approximately ±0.01) dilation, not the paper-derived radius-5-row (approximately ±0.005) dilation.
The doubled window adds 17,520 occupied pixels: stored occupancy 62,005 (fraction 0.269119) versus 44,485 (0.193077) for the paper window. Maximum energy components per α are 26 versus 21.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: Delta-alpha=0.01 is implemented as the paper-defined total window height.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: An independent Harper-matrix implementation reproduces all three printed top eigenvalues, permutations, normalized amplitudes, and direct residuals. The higher-denominator 2/11 curve is substantially closer to 17/93 than the 1/5 curve, supporting the paper's stated common-envelope trend.

independent_checks.claim: Energies are 2.966447989143, 3.028501929591, and 3.023983267910; printed errors are 4.799e-05, 1.930e-06, and 9.019e-11. Stored amplitude discrepancies are at most 4.53e-13 and direct residuals at most 1.95e-15.
Against the 17/93 series, RMS/max differences are 0.2074/0.3008 for 1/5 and 0.0240/0.0504 for 2/11, quantitatively showing convergence with increasing denominator.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The three Fig. 6 eigenpairs, modular reorderings, and convergence trend agree with the paper.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: The authored T007 aggregate is not inventory-complete. Its eleven attested checks omit field-scale estimates, the 5/17 cluster hierarchy, irrational Cantor/measure claims, Landau-level scaling, skeleton asymptotics, and an attested 5/17 reordering check; it also inherits the failed EQ006 field-window definition and the T001 precision defect. The target contract claims paper_exact while the included manifest builder labels T007 paper_subset.

independent_checks.claim: The paper-only inventory contains 11 distinct numeric text/inline items aggregated into T007. At least six are missing or only partially addressed by the eleven attested checks.
Using h/e=4.135667696e-7 G·cm² gives 1.03392e9 G at a=2 Å and 103.392 kG at a=200 Å, consistent with the paper; no corresponding bundled target evidence exists.

Independent α=5/17 bands have their two largest gaps after bands 5 and 12 (both 1.673568804), giving 5-7-5; the largest internal outer/central gaps occur at the printed 2-1-2 and 2-3-2 splits. No frozen T007 datum/check records this.
T007 parameter_match is paper_exact in contracts/target_claims.json but paper_subset in implementation/scripts/build_project_manifest.py.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The eleven attested checks cover every numeric text and inline claim in the phase-1 inventory.

findings.claim: Five positive-width q<50 bands are collapsed to zero width in the frozen float64 spectrum.
reproduction_steps: Recompute the corresponding two Chambers spectra at 90 decimal digits and pair adjacent roots.

findings.claim: The Fig. 2 renderer substitutes a central-band polyline for the paper's next-to-outermost and neighboring-special-case C-chain construction.
reproduction_steps: At α=1/5 compare the renderer's min(abs(low+high)) band with the paper-required next-to-outermost band.
Enumerate the connector families actually created by render_skeleton.

findings.claim: The L₂ formula passes, but one q≤79 sample without convergence evidence cannot decide the full paper figure whose sampling is unprinted.
reproduction_steps: Verify the sole denominator_max value is 79.
Confirm no second cutoff/grid dataset or feature-convergence table is present in the bundle.

findings.claim: Fig. 4 contains 329/513 non-pure local intervals although its caption says all displayed bands belong to the pure-case skeleton.
reproduction_steps: Map every source α to the exact C₂ local fraction.
Retain only local fractions 1/N or 1−1/N and count rejected rows.

findings.claim: The Fig. 5 union uses ±Δα instead of the paper's ±Δα/2, doubling the field-window height.
reproduction_steps: Implement the total-height Δα window as half-width Δα/2.
Compare the corrected Boolean union with stored blurred; count the 17,520 excess pixels.

findings.claim: T007 does not cover all phase-1 quantitative claims and has contradictory paper_exact versus paper_subset declarations.
reproduction_steps: Map the 11 quantitative text/inline inventory rows to attested checks.
Compare T007 parameter_match across the two bundled machine contracts.
